provenance.source: LoKI He / LXCat, existing local converted two-column data (eV,m^2); no raw download redistributed
provenance.scattering: isotropic elastic using momentum-transfer sigma; excitation removes threshold then scatters; WarpX background MCC impact ionization creates electron and He+; no custom redistribution

fluid_provenance.source: Saifutdinov2023 Table 2 R22 (e + He+ + He), (Te/Tg) evaluated with Tg = 300 K
Deloche et al. 1976 PRA 13, 1140 (doi:10.1103/PhysRevA.13.1140): two-body alpha(He2+) < 5e-16 m3/s at 293 K (upper limit, abstract); (Te/Tg)^-1 scaling kept from Saifutdinov2023 R24
fluid_provenance.note: Upper limit used (Saifutdinov2023 R24 prints 5e-15 = 10x the measured bound; changed 2026-11-20). See literature/he-rate-data-verification.md.

fluid_provenance.source: R21/R25 electron-assisted values have ambiguous units in the source; omitted
fluid_provenance.note: Omission underestimates recombination at Te < 0.1 eV.

fluid_provenance.source: no verified K0; ambipolar diffusion disabled (see Ar)

w = nu_ee/(nu_ee+nu_eps): nu_ee NRL Plasma Formulary (2.91e-12 ne lnL Te^-1.5, SI); nu_eps from the LXCat-derived Boltzmann table; criterion Raizer 1991, Lieberman & Lichtenberg 2005; ne/N as Coulomb control parameter: BOLSIG+ manual
fluid_provenance.note: ee_scale = 1; interpolation form k = (1-w) kB + w kM is a modeling choice

provenance.native_banner: WarpX (Unknown), PICSAR 26.10, AMReX 26.11; distribution metadata pywarpx 26.11
provenance.observed_build: native Windows CPU, double fields/particles, 1D Z, Boris, linear shape, energy-conserving gather, multigrid ES; OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; exact used inputs saved per case

resource_estimate.previous_reference: existing 6399-macro/64-cell case: 1394 s / 358333 steps; pilot measures this driver

limits.model: 1D3V electrostatic PIC/MCC, dilute prescribed-field swarm; 1 mm representative local region
limits.rf: E_z=E_peak sin(2*pi*f*t); uncalibrated 50/100 kV/cm peak; no fitted 3.9 multiplier
limits.gas: pure He fixed thermal neutral reservoir, 300 K; no depletion or self-consistent gas heating
limits.seed: illustrative Maxwellian 0.75 eV mean, ne=1e12 m^-3 in central 0.1 mm; laser seed only
limits.boundaries: absorbing particles, Dirichlet plates; no emission; ions move with real He mass
limits.macro_weights: electron number per m^2 transverse area per macro; no physical total without specified transverse area
limits.eedf_normalization: probability per energy bin, weight-normalized by ALL live electrons; density per eV = probability/bin width; overflow reported separately
limits.particles: deterministic fixed initial particle IDs, up to 200; real samples only, births appear in full EEDF not tracked initial sample
limits.solver_resolution: ES: no EM CFL constraint; dx resolves imposed constant field and dilute charge, not dense sheaths. dt resolves electron-neutral collisions; half-dt tested.
limits.dense_plasma_cost: No density, c or mass scaling used. At ne=1e20 m^-3 and Te=1 eV Debye length ~0.74 um: full atmospheric cavity requires enormous cells/particles and ps plasma resolution; not attempted.
limits.stochastic: rare ionization: exact one-sided 95% Poisson count upper limit / measured macro-time exposure; effective constant hazard only
limits.validation_scope: analytic acceleration/relaxation plus numerical cross-code local observables; no experimental validation; grid/domain convergence remains untested

validation.ionization_event_method: created ion macros + scraped ion macros; one product ion per MCC event
validation.energy_work_note: 65-frame quadrature and EEDF expected collision sinks, NOT exact eventwise energy balance
validation.fluid_rate_comparison_applicability: bulk BOLOS local-mean-energy table, Maxwellian fallback below solved EEDF range; same data is not independent experiment
validation.grid_and_domain_convergence: not refined in this step budget; collective/sheath observables not validated
validation.fluid_ionization_comparison: count interval test only; two-cycle transient, no low-field extrapolation
validation.cross_section_range_status: all observed laboratory electron energies below tabulated maxima
validation.density_note: column count / 1mm = domain-averaged density; initial central seed density is 1e12 m^-3, initial domain mean 1e11
validation.energy_standard_error_note: equal-weight macro snapshot IID estimate; correlated ionization families and serial frames mean this is not an independent time-series confidence interval
